Name: Move Between Buildings
Author: vilaboa0008
Description:
[u][size=4]Features[/size]
[/u]
Use path tiles next to buildings to establish connections. The direction of the tile indicates the building you'll move to: left for left, right for right, etc.

For example as shown in the [b]image[/b] below, if you are in a barn and you want to move to a coop to your right, place the path tile to the right of the barn and to the left of the coop.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/thumbnails/17391/17391-1689325083-887378344.png[/img]

Compatibility-wise, this mod works with all buildings that can be built by Robin: barn, coop, shed, slime hutch and greenhouse.
﻿
Note: When there are multiple path tiles, your destination is the path tile next to the wall you come through that is closest to where you left. If there is no path tile next to that wall, you won't be teleported.

You can change the maximum distance between buildings and choose which path types work in config.json, or in-game with Generic Mod Config Menu (optional).

[size=4][u]Installation Instructions
[/u][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
